notes: Placeholder catalog shipped with the companion VRM renderer. Drop a CC0 / VRM Consortium sample model named vrm-sample-a.vrm into this directory to enable VRM rendering. Until the asset is present the runtime's WebGL auto-fallback engages and the pet stays on SVG. License attribution is required by the bundled model's own terms; replace this string with the SPDX-style identifier (e.g. 'CC-BY-4.0', 'CC0-1.0', 'VRM Consortium Sample Data License') before shipping the asset drop.
